findings.problem: Bare "superior" could also be recalled as übergeordnet (higher in rank), hochwertig (of superior quality) or simply besser, so a hint is needed to point to überlegen.
findings.fix: hint: better than someone else, e.g. at a game (ihm ___ sein)

back.target: superior (better than someone in skill, strength or ability)
back.example: She was clearly superior to him at chess.

note: The adjective is stressed on -le- (überlégen), the same as the verb "to consider", and it takes a dative (jemandem überlegen sein), which the editor might mention in the hint or grammar.
